profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 at Boeing
profile.summary:
I'm a master of the complete Software Development Life Cycle, including hardware integration, software/firmware development, documentation and testing. Have expertise in C/C++, C#, Java, Ada, Fortran, among other programming languages. 

A broad background in multiple technologies has enabled me to quickly learn new languages and systems while meeting performance and scheduling goals. My passion is to continue learning and improving my development skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Software Industry · Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Development of 70+ multi-threaded feed-handler software programs in C on a Linux Centos 7 platform to format news story files for digital publishing. 
•Converted stories from various formats (XML/HTML/JSON/ANPA/Text ) into XML/ NewSml formatted documents. 
•Developed 13 Bash scripts to access APIs over the internet to retrieve data to create news story files for processing.
•Ported legacy feed handlers from C++ to standardized feed framework. 
•Converted existing feed handlers from Centos 5 on AWS to Centos 7 on Google cloud.
Fixed data typing problem causing discrepancies between legacy systems and updated systems.
•Tools: C/C++, Linux, Bash Shell Scripting, Jira Tracking, SVN Configuration Management.

positions.title: Senior Retail Manager
positions.description:
• Area Manager of operations. 
• Responsible for hiring and training managers and sales associates for multiple locations. 
• Trained over 10 store managers, 15 assistant managers, and 60+ employees. 
• Worked days and attended college at night to earn BS degree.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Upgraded semiconductor testing system software to updated SEMI standards using C++ with Windows Visual Studio platform. 
• Performed Object-Oriented Design using UML diagrams.
• Created and maintained Design Documentation, Software Specifications and Acceptance Test Documentation.
• Developed Remote/Host Interfacing software and Operator Interface software using in-house SDK.
• Tools: Visual C++, MS Source Safe Configuration Management, UML, and TCL

positions.title: Systems Analyst II, Geneva Steel, Vinyard
positions.description:
• Maintained and upgraded Level II rolling mill tracking system to monitor and report status of steel bars in rolling mill. 
• Created Design and Coding standards to ISO-9000 specifications. 
• Upgraded and maintained inter-system communication software.
• Maintained and updated database storage/retrieval software with AllBase Embedded SQL.
• Developed GUI programs for data plotting/reporting using Athena Widgets in Motif.
• Upgraded all applicable systems for Y2K compatibility. 	
Tools: C/C++, X-Windows/Motif, HP-UX on HP 9000, AllBase SQL, RCS configuration management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helicopter simulator
●	Performed all phases of software lifecycle on real time subsystems in flight simulator used for flight training. 
●	Responsible for writing Software Test specifications for government testing.
●	Developed software for a FLIR Night Vision System Interface (FLIR) using raw Ethernet (UDP). 
●	Developed data & parameter storage/retrieval software, reverse engineered existing software from FORTRAN into Ada and upgraded functionality to new specifications on a UNIX (HP-UX) platform.
●	SCCS configuration management system.

Sonar Receiver Tester
●	Designed, developed and produced Sonar Receiver Tester, which included: designing hardware platform using VMEbus system, developing host software in C to interface with DSP boards in an OS/9 platform, downloading firmware to DSP boards and initiating execution, and developed real time embedded system code for micro-controller using a windows-based cross-development system. 
●	PVCS configuration management system.

positions.title: Senior Electronic Equipment Specialist,
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented real time embedded system for operator interface for electronic support equipment using C.
•	Performed debugging and testing of operator interface software.
•	Created and maintained software requirements, user documentation and software test documentation compliant with DOD-STD-2167 specifications for Titan IV nose cone assembly software testing.
•	Implemented software process improvements using object oriented-type design approach.
•	Designed software/firmware/hardware for a microcomputer-based Timer and Alert system for a manufacturing/production line using C language.
•	Designed, developed and produced an in-house microcontroller board for use in interfacing incompatible systems using C and assembly.  Designed schematic and board layout, as well as, built and tested prototype.
•	Received several Cost Savings/Quality Improvement awards.
•	Tools: C, Assembly Language, PDOS on VMEbus platform
